title: Properties with Holes: Meta-Property-Based Testing of Data-Intensive Computing Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2606.11132v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Data-intensive computing frameworks such as Apache Spark and Flink keep expanding their APIs with new data types, expressions, and operators. Their most damaging bugs return silently wrong results rather than crashing, which tools that detect only crashes or exceptions cannot see. Property-based testing can catch such bugs, but only if someone writes a property with a strong oracle, and writing properties one API at a time cannot keep pace with this growth. We observe that many such properties are instances of a few textbook principles: congruence of equivalent expressions, relational-algebra equivalences, and aggregate decomposition. Each principle holds not only for an isolated operator but also for any workload built around it.   We present Holey, which introduces meta-properties: properties with holes. A meta-property fixes how a workload is transformed and which relation its outputs must satisfy, but leaves open the expressions

translated_title: 带洞的性质：基于元性质的数据密集型计算框架测试
translated_abstract: Apache Spark和Flink等数据密集型计算框架正不断通过新的数据类型、表达式和算子扩展其API。其最具破坏性的缺陷是静默地返回错误结果而非崩溃，因此仅能检测崩溃或异常的工具对此无能为力。基于性质的测试能够捕捉这类缺陷，但前提是有人编写带有强判定器的性质，而逐个API地编写性质无法跟上API的增长速度。我们观察到，许多这类性质都是少数教科书式原则的实例：等价表达式的同余性、关系代数等价性以及聚合分解。每条原则不仅对孤立算子成立，也对围绕该算子构建的任意工作负载成立。我们提出了Holey，它引入了元性质，即带洞的性质：元性质固定了工作负载如何被变换以及其输出必须满足何种关系，但将表达式留空待填……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Holey工具，引入“带洞的元性质”这一概念——固定工作负载的变换方式与输出需满足的关系、将表达式留空以待填充——从而系统化地为Spark、Flink等数据密集型计算框架生成强判定性质的测试，捕捉那些静默返回错误结果的缺陷。
en_tdlr: Holey introduces meta-properties—properties with holes that fix how a workload is transformed and which relation its outputs must satisfy while leaving expressions to be filled in—enabling scalable, strong-oracle property-based testing to catch silently wrong results in data-intensive computing frameworks such as Apache Spark and Flink.
